Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Our operations primarily involve the retail sale of a wide variety of paints, wallpaper, and related home improvement products. We offer expert advice on color selection and application techniques, assist customers in choosing the right materials for their projects, and conduct in-store demonstrations on painting and wallpaper installation. To enhance customer convenience, we maintain a well-organized inventory, emphasizing safety with secure storage and effective inventory management practices. Our store adheres to local fire and safety codes, ensuring a clean and accessible shopping environment for all customers. Additionally, we implement theft prevention measures, including a monitored alarm system, and maintain comprehensive insurance coverage to protect against potential risks associated with our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 01/10/2023, the store experienced a minor water leak due to a burst pipe, resulting in damage to the flooring and some inventory. The total estimated loss was $2,500. The claim was filed, and the status is closed after the repairs were completed on 02/15/2023.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored alarm system in place; fencing around perimeter; limited store hours from 8 AM to 6 PM.
